description: This file contains utility functions and a class for matching subgraphs within a PyTorch FX GraphModule, supporting node name mapping for pattern matching in graph transformations.

classes.name: SubgraphMatcherWithNameNodeMap
classes.description: A subclass of SubgraphMatcher that supports querying matched subgraph nodes via node names, enabling pattern matching with node name mappings.

methods.name: _split_to_graph_and_name_node_map
methods.description: Splits a GraphModule into its graph and a dictionary mapping node names to nodes, modifying the graph to include this mapping.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the SubgraphMatcherWithNameNodeMap with a pattern GraphModule, extracting a node name map.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs pattern matching on a graph, returning matches with node names mapped to target nodes.
